limitations: The bound 4/3 is not established as optimal for the completed tower.
The result concerns the canonical first positive level of the c0 tower and not arbitrary Banach spaces.
Independent validation and exhaustive novelty certification are not claimed.
scientific_integrity: The statement is proved for complex spaces and infinite index sets by a full analytic argument. It does not claim that the universal lower bound is sharp.
title: A uniform complement-norm gap for the first bidual-tower layer of \(c_0(\Gamma)\)
